title: Revolutionize Your SEO Audits with Claude SEO on GitHub!
contentMarkdown:
## 📝 Quick Summary: 
Claude SEO is an open-source plugin for Claude Code that performs comprehensive SEO analysis. It leverages 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents to cover a wide range of SEO aspects, providing prioritized, actionable recommendations grounded in primary-source guidance.

## 🔑 Key Takeaways

- ✅ Claude SEO is an open-source, AI-powered plugin for Claude Code that automates comprehensive SEO audits.

- ✅ It covers a wide range of SEO aspects including technical, content quality (E-E-A-T), Schema.org, AI search optimization, local, e-commerce, and international SEO.

- ✅ The tool offers parallel execution, completing full site audits in minutes and providing 'AI-search first' recommendations aligned with Google's latest guidance.

- ✅ It delivers falsifiable, actionable, and testable recommendations, making it invaluable for agencies, in-house teams, and freelance consultants.

- ✅ Claude SEO significantly boosts audit efficiency and helps identify critical SEO issues often missed by other tools.


## 📊 Project Statistics
- ⭐ Stars: 16332
- 🍴 Forks: 2386
- ❗ Open Issues: 13


## 🛠 Tech Stack
- ✅ Python


Hey fellow developers and tech enthusiasts! I just stumbled upon an absolute game-changer on GitHub that I simply have to share with you: **Claude SEO**. If you've ever wrestled with the complexities of SEO audits, spent countless hours manually checking every detail, or wished for a smarter, faster way to ensure your projects rank high, then you *need* to check this out. Claude SEO is an open-source SEO analysis plugin specifically designed for Claude Code, and it's here to transform how we approach search engine optimization.

So, what makes Claude SEO so incredibly cool? Imagine having a team of 25 sub-skills and 18 specialist agents working in parallel, all focused on dissecting your site's SEO performance. This isn't just a basic checker; it dives deep into every crucial aspect, from technical SEO foundations and content quality (think E-E-A-T principles for expertise and authority) to Schema.org markup, AI search optimization (GEO), local SEO, e-commerce specifics, and even international SEO considerations. It’s like having an entire SEO agency in your Claude Code environment, ready to go.

One of the most impressive features is its 'AI-search first' approach. In today's AI-driven world, Google's algorithms are constantly evolving. Claude SEO is built with Google's AI Optimization Guide in mind, focusing on things like question-based citability scoring and agent-friendly page checks. This means your site isn't just optimized for traditional search, but for the future of AI-powered discovery. Plus, the parallel execution is a huge time-saver. Full site audits that used to take hours can now be completed in minutes, thanks to up to 15 specialist agents running simultaneously. This is a massive boost for productivity!

What truly sets Claude SEO apart is its commitment to 'falsifiable, not promotional' recommendations. Every single suggestion it provides comes with the core observation it's based on, its dependencies, a clear way to verify if it failed, and a leading indicator. This means you get transparent, actionable, and testable recommendations, not just generic advice. For SEO agencies, this translates to replacing lengthy quarterly audits with weekly automated runs, drastically increasing audit cadence without expanding your team. In-house SEO leads can use it as a powerful second opinion, catching issues that might slip past Google Search Console or Lighthouse. And for freelance consultants, it’s a fantastic tool to quickly anchor client scope with a comprehensive audit and a clear score, proving immediate value.

Seriously, if you're looking to streamline your SEO workflow, gain deeper insights, and stay ahead in the ever-changing world of search, Claude SEO is a project you absolutely must explore. It's powerful, open-source, and incredibly smart. Go give it a star on GitHub and integrate it into your workflow!
